questions.stem: During a temporal artery biopsy for suspected giant cell arteritis, which of the following factors is MOST important for improving diagnostic yield?
questions.stemHtml: During a temporal artery biopsy for suspected giant cell arteritis, which of the following factors is MOST important for improving diagnostic yield?

options.label: A
options.text: Obtaining a biopsy sample from the most tender area of the artery

options.label: B
options.text: Using a large bore needle for biopsy

options.label: C
options.text: Obtaining a biopsy segment of at least 3-5 cm in length

options.label: D
options.text: Performing the biopsy under general anesthesia
